dataset_grain.delayed_selected_event_ledger: one selected S3d-O8 W2 detector event per row
dataset_grain.delayed_source_point_ledger: one unique delayed source coordinate/key per row
dataset_grain.prompt_events: one traced active-veto W2 prompt survivor per row
dataset_grain.verified_origin_links: one exact selected-event to activation-production-origin link per row

risk_findings.finding: Activation projectile/channel ancestry is exact for only 25/420 selected delayed events (5.95%).
risk_findings.impact: The verified-origin projectile distribution cannot be treated as the projectile mix of all delayed W2 background.

risk_findings.finding: Delayed weighted evidence is low-Neff and quantized: family-specific selected rows carry one constant event weight.
risk_findings.impact: Single p/n/alpha events create large equal-height ranking steps; the apparent ordering among equal-rate source points is not resolved.

risk_findings.finding: Official Step05 prompt evidence contains only two equal-weight events.
risk_findings.impact: Prompt-host fractions are mechanism examples, not stable population fractions.

near_field_figure_recommendation.point_semantics: Plot source coordinates by orthographic x'-z' projection and state each point's true y'; do not imply the point lies in the y'=0 section.
near_field_figure_recommendation.top10_tie_warning: P0060/P0061/P0062/P0063/P0064/P0065/P0066 are equal-weight single-p events; their internal rank is arbitrary.
